newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile stocks end broadly higher on technical buys.
newsitem.headline: Chile stocks end broadly higher on technical buys.

text.p: Chilean stocks extended their afternoon gains to close broadly higher on technical buying off last week's tumble and on Wall Street's rises, brokers said.
The blue-chip IPSA index ended 1.22 percent higher to end at 91.66 points. The all-share IGPA closed 0.6 percent higher at 5019.17 points on moderate volume of 11 billion pesos.
